d: Jet black hair is styled in a single long, thin braid that curves behind the back, with short bangs framing the face. The eyes are a bright golden-yellow with a focused, sharp expression behind red-rimmed circular glasses. This person appears as a mature adolescent with a slender, petite build and tan skin. The outfit consists of a short red zip-up hoodie worn over black shorts, layered under a long, oversized white lab coat that flows outward and features lime green stains. Surrounding the figure are four large, floating black and white mechanical cubes equipped with dual cannons and orange circular accents.
